reference_lenses.lagna: Core identity, physical vitality, self-concept, and day-to-day initiative[cite: 1, 2].
reference_lenses.chandra_lagna: Emotional mind, reactive sensitivity, and how ambition or stress feels internally[cite: 1, 2, 3].
reference_lenses.ravi_lagna: Core drive, long-term purpose, and steady vitality[cite: 2].
reference_lenses.arudha_lagna: How others perceive the person in public and material life—distinct from internal reality[cite: 2].

1.growth_focus: Balancing personal momentum with self-awareness rather than forcing every outcome[cite: 1].

4.theme: Emotional home base, inner security, comfort, foundational roots[cite: 1, 2, 6].
4.growth_focus: Protecting personal recovery space and emotional steadiness to anchor outward action[cite: 1, 2].

5.theme: Creative expression, romance spark, play, discernment[cite: 2, 6].
5.growth_focus: Channeling creative energy and attraction without mistaking intensity for long-term fit[cite: 2, 3].

6.theme: Daily work habits, problem-solving, friction points, health routines[cite: 1, 2, 6].
6.growth_focus: Turning analytical troubleshooting and work ethic into sustainable systems without overwork or perfectionism[cite: 1, 2].

7.theme: One-on-one partnerships, romantic attraction, collaboration, mirror dynamics[cite: 1, 2, 6].
7.growth_focus: Practicing clear boundaries, mutual respect, and steady communication instead of reactive projection[cite: 2, 3].

8.theme: Deep transitions, shared trust, underlying tension, resilience[cite: 2, 6].
8.growth_focus: Navigating sudden shifts or vulnerability through calm transparency rather than secrecy or urgency[cite: 2, 3].

9.theme: Long-range vision, ethics, mentorship, big-picture meaning[cite: 1, 2, 6].
9.growth_focus: Aligning daily choices with principled values and wider perspective[cite: 1, 2].

10.theme: Career direction, public contribution, leadership, tangible execution[cite: 1, 2, 6].
10.growth_focus: Building meaningful impact and steady authority while pacing ambition sustainably[cite: 1, 2].

12.theme: Rest, solitude, subconscious processing, sleep, letting go[cite: 1, 2, 6].
12.growth_focus: Honoring downtime and mental decompression rather than overworking when tired[cite: 1, 2].

planet_in_house_patterns.trait: High drive to solve problems, debug systems, and push through tough tasks[cite: 1, 2].
planet_in_house_patterns.blind_spot: Impatience, over-pushing during stress, or turning routine tasks into battles[cite: 1, 2, 3].
planet_in_house_patterns.actionable_shift: Use time-boxed work sprints and release physical tension before responding to friction[cite: 1, 3].

planet_in_house_patterns.trait: Strong visibility drive, leadership presence, and desire for meaningful public impact[cite: 1, 2].
planet_in_house_patterns.blind_spot: Ego sensitivity or carrying heavy responsibility alone[cite: 1, 3].
planet_in_house_patterns.actionable_shift: Anchor leadership in clear outcomes and delegate routine tasks early[cite: 1, 2].

planet_in_house_patterns.trait: Seriousness about quiet reflection, boundaries, and deeper life lessons[cite: 1, 2].
planet_in_house_patterns.blind_spot: Light sleep, mental heaviness, or withdrawing instead of asking for support[cite: 1, 2, 3].
planet_in_house_patterns.actionable_shift: Protect a wind-down routine and avoid major life commitments when mentally depleted[cite: 1, 3].

planet_in_house_patterns.trait: Appreciation for harmony, charm, mutual care, and relational connection[cite: 1, 2, 6].
planet_in_house_patterns.blind_spot: People-pleasing, idealizing early chemistry, or avoiding direct boundary conversations[cite: 2, 3].
planet_in_house_patterns.actionable_shift: Pair warmth with honest pacing so emotional needs stay clear over time[cite: 2, 3].
